subclass.isekai_mahou.mage_archmage.desc: The library mage: a huge mana pool that never runs dry.
subclass.isekai_mahou.mage_archmage.play: Keep your mana full: above 75%% your spells hit harder, and some of them cost half.
subclass.isekai_mahou.mage_battlemage.de: Magic on the front line: hits harder and pays for damage taken with mana.
subclass.isekai_mahou.mage_battlemage.pl: Fight up close: within 5 blocks your spells hit harder, and every cast heals you.
subclass.isekai_mahou.witch_hexer.desc: Every hit carries a curse: the enemy weakens, rots and falls.
subclass.isekai_mahou.witch_hexer.play: Pile curses on the enemy: cursed targets take far more damage and, when they die, pass the curses on.
subclass.isekai_mahou.witch_apothecary.d: Mistress of potions: every heal goes further and the body mends itself.
subclass.isekai_mahou.witch_apothecary.p: Cast to stay standing: every spell heals you and, out of combat, a barrier rebuilds itself.
subclass.isekai_mahou.warlock_fiend.desc: A pact of fire and blood: the closer to death, the stronger the flame.
subclass.isekai_mahou.warlock_fiend.play: Fight on the edge: at low health you hit harder and take less, and every hit you take powers your next one.
Serves what lives in the dark: deeper shadows, and foreign magic slides off.
Keep your distance: from afar your spells hit harder and may echo, striking twice.
subclass.isekai_mahou.druid_warden.desc: Becomes the forest itself: hard bark, thorns and a body that never stops growing back.
subclass.isekai_mahou.druid_warden.play: Be the wall: whoever hits you is slowed, and what you block goes back to the attacker.
Runs with the pack: beasts hit far harder and every hunt feeds the group.
Point at the target and the pack does the rest: what you hit is marked, and the beasts' damage heals you.
subclass.isekai_mahou.necromancer_lichbo: Trades flesh for power: stronger shadows and a death that is slow to take hold.
The mage of the dead: with full mana your spells hit harder and may echo, striking twice.
subclass.isekai_mahou.necromancer_gravel: General of the dead: the army hits for him and every enemy loss sustains him.
The general: while the army fights you take less damage, and its damage becomes your health.
subclass.isekai_mahou.smith_weaponmaster: Forges to kill: every weapon he makes cuts deeper and lands where it hurts.
Keep hitting the same target: each hit in a row hurts more and every 5th hit is a heavy critical.
subclass.isekai_mahou.smith_ironwall.des: Forges to last: a walking wall that returns the blow to whoever strikes.
subclass.isekai_mahou.smith_ironwall.pla: Block and parry: your guard returns the blow to the attacker and makes you even tougher for a few seconds.
subclass.isekai_mahou.rogue_assassin.des: One strike, from behind, on a target that doesn't yet know the fight has started.
subclass.isekai_mahou.rogue_assassin.pla: Open from behind and finish fast: the first strike is huge and common enemies near death drop at once.
subclass.isekai_mahou.rogue_trickster.de: Never where the blow lands: luck, poison and quick legs.
subclass.isekai_mahou.rogue_trickster.pl: Dodge and strike back: every dodge primes a counter, and your hits land unpredictably — weak or very strong.
subclass.isekai_mahou.knight_paladin.des: The sword of light: the undead burn and healing works better on him.
subclass.isekai_mahou.knight_paladin.pla: The light heals those who fight: every technique used and every parried blow gives health back.
subclass.isekai_mahou.knight_vanguard.de: First in, last to fall: armor, health and guard to spare.
subclass.isekai_mahou.knight_vanguard.pl: Hold the line: a parry primes a heavy counterblow, and every block hardens your guard.
subclass.isekai_mahou.enchanter_nullifie: Anti-Magic in person: spells hit him and die.
The anti-mage: magic barely scratches you, bosses hit softer, and what you block goes back to the attacker.
subclass.isekai_mahou.enchanter_heavenly: The Heavenly Restriction pushed to the limit: less magic, an absurd body.
Body only: stick to the enemy and never stop hitting — up close and in a row, each punch hurts more.
subclass.isekai_mahou.shinigami_kenpachi: Just the blade and the will to fight: the worse the fight, the better he gets.
No defense, only attack: you hit harder and get hit harder — and every blow you take powers your next one.
subclass.isekai_mahou.shinigami_kido_mas: The demon arts above the sword: more power, more reiryoku, bound enemies.
Chain your Kidō: every technique used raises the damage of the next ones, and your Kidō may echo.
subclass.isekai_mahou.quincy_sternritter: Knight of the stars: arrows of light that never miss the weak spot.
Shoot from afar: targets 12+ blocks away take far more damage, and every critical speeds up the slaughter.
Blood as armor: takes the blow and still gathers reishi from the fight.
Blood as armor: a barrier that rebuilds out of combat and shocks whoever hits you.
subclass.isekai_mahou.gunslinger_deadeye: One shot, one target: the first bullet decides the fight.
Crouch and aim: sneaking and from afar, every shot is close to a sentence.
Shoots on the run and vanishes in smoke: fire, legs and no rules.
Never stop: while sprinting you shoot harder, and every kill advances your cooldowns.
subclass.isekai_mahou.ranger_sharpshoote: The bow above all: the first arrow arrives before the enemy notices.
Keep your distance and stay on one target: from afar, each arrow in a row hurts more than the last.
subclass.isekai_mahou.ranger_beastmaster: Fights as a pair: companions hit far harder and the hunt sustains both.
Fight as a pair: mark a target with a hit and your companions tear it apart — and shield you while they fight.
subclass.isekai_mahou.gambler_high_rolle: All or nothing: lucky hits that double damage, and better bets when health runs out.
All or nothing: every hit is a bet — it may land weak or VERY strong — and criticals pay out in health.
The house always wins: walks away unharmed, luck in pocket and the bank full.
The house always wins: dodge and strike back, and watch some of your techniques cost half.
subclass.isekai_mahou.steelball_executio: The Spin as a sentence: whoever is already wounded does not get up again.
Finish the job: common enemies near death drop at once, and every execution makes you stronger.
The Spin as medicine: the body mends itself in the middle of the fight.
The Spin heals: criticals give health back and, the more wounded you are, the harder you are to bring down.
subclass.isekai_mahou.hollowfied_devoure: Eats to live: every hit and every kill fills the hole in the chest.
Eat to live: your hits heal you, and common enemies near death are devoured on the spot.
subclass.isekai_mahou.hollowfied_berserk: Pure instinct: faster, stronger and worse still when dying.
Pure rage: you deal and take more damage, and every blow you take feeds your next one.
